mentions.name: shoehorn.dev
mentions.description: An opinionated, self-hosted, event-driven internal developer platform positioned as a modern, smarter alternative to Backstage. It is Kubernetes-native with an API-first Go microservice backend and deploys in about 15 minutes via Docker Compose or Helm charts, and can be configured through a Terraform provider. A Kubernetes push-agent pushes kinds, auto-creates entities into the API in batches, and forwards pod events. The modular Svelte frontend lets users choose what to show, with features including OIDC and org-data sync for Okta, Zitadel, and Entra ID, RBAC management, Meilisearch-based instant search, auto-generated org charts from nested teams/departments, Svelte Flow-based dependency (relations) visualization, entity compliance views, full GitHub integration, and a widget/integration community.
mentions.audience: Engineering teams via an internal developer platform, with self-hosting support
mentions.source_excerpt: we've been building on a next gen event-driven internal developer platform, an an opinionated selfhosted platform "shoehorn.dev" - deploy with ease within 15 min (docker compose or helmcharts). You could say its a modern backstage.
